Coinbase, Circle, Ripple, Mastercard and t54 Labs share x402 Foundation participation. Coinbase contributed x402 to Linux Foundation governance; Circle supports x402 with USDC; Ripple supports XRP and RLUSD on XRPL. This is a shared open standard, not an exclusive commercial partnership.

Reclassify as x402-compatible agent micropayments; operator and production/test status unknown. No malicious intent or Binance corporate attribution is established.
